title: Impresos populares iberoamericanos
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: It offers a fascinating journey through the history of popular printed matter from the 15th century to the present day, highlighting its far-reaching cultural impact and its remarkable enduring relevance. Drawing on a study of ‘pliegos de cordel’ and other widely circulated formats, the volume demonstrates how these materials gave shape to news, stories and entertainment that circulated both orally and in book form, becoming part of the collective memory.
